3682-4779-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3682-4779-5660-6769.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Mox Amber, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

719-3510-3875-6291.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Xenograft.
719-3510-3875-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

765-2645-3181-3430.easyPrerequisites: Krosan Restorer doesn't have summoning sickness.
765-2645-3181-3430.description:
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Krosan Restorer by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Krosan Restorer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1339-5686-7920.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-5686-7920.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

997-4694-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-4694-4802-7306.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 1.

1981-2415-3641-4050.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3641-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

4186-6566-6798--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4772-4826-7824-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

3263-6798-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
3263-6798-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Mycosynth Lattice and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Umbral Collar Zealot.

101-1987-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
101-1987-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
101-1987-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

129-1409-4068-4289.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
129-1409-4068-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-527-4742.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-4742.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2506-2557-7150-7752.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

997-5571-7666--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2445-3099-4762-6774.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Loading Zone and Branching Evolution.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

5143-6871-7033.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Bumi triggers, untapping all lands you control, including Bumi as it's a land due to Toph, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1874-2919-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-2919-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

2468-6587-6588-7012.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

656-1793-5220.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Harvester of Souls.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Ugin's Conjurant from your library.
Repeat.

339-677-6791-6798.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2558-3490-4050-5330-6701.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Repeat.
2558-3490-4050-5330-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

2060-2438-2577-6701.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-2438-2577-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

600-2232-4153.notablePrerequisites: Jace has at least five loyalty counters on it.
600-2232-4153.description:
Activate Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two token copies of Jace that aren't legendary.
When the Jace tokens enter the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, returning a Jace token from the battlefield to your hand.
When the Jace token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting three loyalty counters on the remaining Jace token.
Repeat using the Jace token.

2099-2558-5687-5691.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Street Riot, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-4659-5263.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding {C}{C}.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader, adding {C}{C}.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Repeat.

2733-4050-4094-5043.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2733-4050-4094-5043.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Faerie tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-4871-5695-5752.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Brokkos.
When Brokkos dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder four times by sacrificing four Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U/B}{G}{G}.
Cast Brokkos from your graveyard for its mutate cost by paying {2}{U/B}{G}{G}, putting it on top of a Saproling.
Repeat from step 3.

1863-3308-3946.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2034-2882-3819-4221-5220.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two land cards in hand.
Infinite Reflection attached to Cultivator Colossus.
2034-2882-3819-4221-5220.description:
Play any land from your hand.
The land enters the battlefield as a copy of Cultivator Colossus due to Living Plane and Infinite Reflection.
When the land enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land, adding {C}{C}.
When the land dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the land on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the land's trigger from step 3, causing you to put any other land onto the battlefield from your hand, draw a card, and then decline to put another land onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1908-2743.notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least two instant and/or sorcery spells this turn.
1908-2743.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Rionya triggers, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary with haste.
At the beginning of your end step, Rionya and each Biovisionary trigger.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

1215-2034-3184.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hope of Ghirapur, adding {C}{C}.
Hope of Ghirapur dies, triggering Yomiji, returning Hope of Ghirapur from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Hope of Ghirapur by paying {1}.
Repeat.

380-844-2232-2972.description:
Cast Slumbering Dragon by paying {R}.
Slumbering Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, Ganax and Miirym.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a token copy of Slumbering Dragon.
The Slumbering Dragon token enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Ganax.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Slumbering Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

148-4106-4869.notablePrerequisites:
An additional card in hand.
The number of cards in library is greater than each opponent's life total.
Keen Sense attached to Glint-Horn Buccaneer.
148-4106-4869.description:
Activate Aquamoeba by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Keen Sense triggers for each opponent dealt damage.
Resolve one trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Holding priority, repeat.
Repeat.

539-2203-4657.easyPrerequisites: You control two mana-producing lands other than Magus of the Candelabra.
539-2203-4657.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Vorinclex triggers twice, adding {2}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

2757-4684-5318.description:
Pay {G} to Kamahl, targeting the basic land.
Tap the basic land with Earthcraft, untapping itself.
Mesmeric Orb triggers milling you 1.
Repeat.

1744-1953-2105.description:
Cast Rite of Replication by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare one of the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2358-3350-4695.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Axis of Mortality triggers.
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and one life, adding {B}.
Repeat step 2 until you have zero life.
Resolve the Axis of Mortality trigger, swapping your life total with an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.

45-1987-2556-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
45-1987-2556-3075.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.

813-1987-2427-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
